title: Zilla Panchayat may raise loans and form a sinking fund

versions.Latest:
170 .   Zilla Panchayat may raise loans and form a sinking fund.—   A Zilla Panchayat 
may, with the previous sanction of the Government and subject to the conditions imposed 
by it from time to time, raise loans for the execution of any work or for the purpose of 
carrying out any of the provisions of this Act and form a sinking fund for the repayment 
of such loans.
